signal.rolloff_note: RECT ignores rolloff for waveform generation, but 0.35 is the final runner/UI setting and is recorded so the config matches scripts/rf_bpsk_ui_board_session.py:310 and pynq_overlay/sw/rf_teaching_profile.py:53
signal.amplitude_note: max(max|I|, max|Q|) == 60, matching the product TX generator's component peak semantics; this is the same amplitude used by the final board runner (rf_teaching_profile tx_amplitude=60)

tx_payload.note: 127 PRBS symbols x 20 samples/symbol = 2540 complex samples at 60 MSPS; this is the finite TX payload/period.

reference_window.note: 4096-sample software/model reference window: one full 2540-sample period plus the first 1556 samples of the next period; no resampling.

mapping.bit_order: MSB-first; first serial bit maps to I, later bits to Q

truth.source: independent PRBS7 + frozen constellation mapping reconstruction; configuration seeds, not model predictions

limits: These are offline-generated TX payload candidates, not real RF captures.
Amplitude 60 payloads are not byte-identical to the existing amplitude-1800 vectors; byte equality is not claimed.
A real RF received IQ is not expected to equal the ideal payload byte-for-byte.
Frozen-model results are reported as-is; amplitude/model/threshold are not tuned to force acceptance.
